caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal decorative element composed of a central human face, which is pale with dark hair and is shown on a round, gold-colored background. The figure wears a red garment. On either side of the face, there are symmetrical, ornate gold scrolls and leaf motifs that curve outward and upward, filling an elongated, rounded rectangular frame. The background inside the frame is a light gray color. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the face as the central focal point and the decorative gold elements extending laterally to the left and right within the outlined shape. The background of the image itself is off-white or beige, with no additional objects or patterns. Handwritten notes appear in light gray pencil at the bottom right corner.
title: Stern Piece
